app.title: Janas: Run LLMs larger than RAM by streaming experts from SSD
app.author: khalidkhair
app.description: LLM inference framework that streams model weights from SSD to enable running large models on limited RAM.
proposed_tests: Load a 13B model from disk and run a simple prompt, check latency.
Run the same prompt with vLLM and compare throughput.
